title: One-Shot Iterator
description: min_max(raw) takes numbers as strings and returns [smallest, largest] as numbers. It crashes every time.
hint: `map` doesn't return a list. What's left in it after `min()` has read every value?
explanation: `map` returns a lazy iterator, and an iterator can only be consumed once. `min()` reads every value, so `max()` gets an empty iterator and raises ValueError. Store the values in a list if you need to go over them more than once.
